evidence: Each file's suite, the full database suites and the PG16 upgrade rehearsal on throwaway clusters with fictional data only, as posted on hid-system#258 with the sha256 of each file. 0128: the PIN-use inbox notice naming the clinician, role and facility; the access-request list names the requester. 0129: a staff member's chosen facility kept per sign-in (behind STAFF_FACILITY_SELECTION_MODE, off by default). 0130: front-desk registration without a NIN (phone required except for a child; the desk creates the record with no possible duplicate, otherwise an approver who did not start it decides). 0131: doctors, nurses and clinicians open their own facility's patient for 24 hours without a PIN (registered here or a consented visit here in 24 months), shown in the patient's access history and revocable by the patient. 0132: staff patient search (strong keys everywhere, weak keys own facility only) and emergency search by exact names and date of birth (break-glass holders, a reason, shown in the patient's access log); cards carry a 10-minute matchRef, never a Health ID or patient id. 0135: the waiting list (check-in by matchRef or own-facility patient, stage, triage, assignee; no clinical content; not a visit). 0136: the role-table changes of Q103 A with Q111 A and Q112 A; stops at apply, changing nothing, if any real (non-sealed) staff would be affected (Q113 A). 0137: QoreID asked once per NIN, its stored answer (a matched record not yet on a Health ID for 90 days, Q110) and its hold. Every file is additive or replaces bodies it pins by md5; runtime-grants.sql grants exactly what the files grant.
